title: CIVICS: Building a Dataset for Examining Culturally-Informed Values in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model agreement and refusal rates to value-laden prompts across five languages and nine national contexts using next-token log-probabilities and automated evaluation of long-form responses.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
